Edit this image into the last part of the same clean, text-free photographic plate. Remove every non-photographic overlay below the top band and fill it with what would be behind it: all Japanese text and numbers, every thin orange line and bracket, every round orange dot. Where text sat over the dark background on the left, continue the dark cliff and night forest naturally.
Keep the rooms, furniture, floor positions and building edges where they are in the input. Redraw the photographic detail sharply at full resolution.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, lines, dots, icons or UI. No people. Landscape 3:2, the same size as the input.
